parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `MetadataMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift`. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Additionally, the two types differ in a semantically meaningful way: `responses` is typed `[Data]` in the Artwork mock (an ordered sequence keyed by request order) versus `[String: Data]` in the Metadata mock (a dictionary keyed by some string identifier), reflecting genuinely different stubbing strategies for their respective test suites. Lifting these into a shared PAT would couple test infrastructure across unrelated packages without a clear production benefit.
